facts.fact: In Lablache v Lablache, Burian J found there was no way to authenticate the digital signature and that the judiciary had no policy or structure yet to verify digital signatures, so wet-ink signatures must be used.
facts.system: digital signature verification for court filings

facts.fact: The Supreme Court of Seychelles states that the Electronic Transactions Act 2001 provides the legal framework for digital signatures, and that its 2024 schedule amendment removed the Code of Civil Procedure from the exempted laws.

SYC.note: The Land Registration Act appears only in a list of laws exempt from the e-transactions Act.
